hypothesis: Learn an exactly reconstructible autoregressive SeqFlow map from padded SELFIES token sequences to continuous token-block latent codes, then conduct task-local Bayesian optimization entirely over oracle-evaluated latent-score pairs: generate de novo candidates by uniform blockwise perturbation inside adaptive trust regions centered on high-scoring evaluated anchors, inverse-decode a fresh valid novel pool, and use Gaussian-process posterior Thompson samples to choose each batch so returned rewards condition both later acquisition and trust-region state.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: Gaussian-process posterior Thompson selection over a freshly generated trust-region candidate pool
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only SeqFlow training plus a task-local latent Gaussian process fit only to oracle-evaluated molecule-score pairs
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: evaluated-anchor trust-region perturbation of latent token blocks followed by inverse-flow de novo decoding
method_tags.representation: SELFIES token sequences mapped to an exactly reconstructible continuous latent space by an autoregressive normalizing flow

activation_observables.measurement: For a fixed held-out corpus sample and for every molecule admitted to an objective session, encode its padded SELFIES token sequence, apply the exact inverse flow with zero perturbation, and report both exact token-sequence reconstruction rate and canonical-SMILES reconstruction rate, with tokenization, length, and out-of-vocabulary failures retained in the denominator.
activation_observables.name: exact_seqflow_roundtrip_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every generated trust-region point, record the eligible token blocks, their configured selection probabilities, and the selected blocks; report the maximum configured probability difference and the cumulative total-variation distance between empirical block-selection frequencies and the uniform distribution, relative to a fully concentrated block-selection reference.
activation_observables.name: uniform_token_block_probability_deviation

activation_observables.measurement: For every emitted canonical molecule, retain its oracle-evaluated anchor identifier, trust-region radius, selected token-block indices, latent displacement, and inverse-decoded SELFIES; report the fraction with at least one selected block changed, every unselected block unchanged, displacement within the recorded region, and a complete anchor-to-decode trace.
activation_observables.name: evaluated_anchor_trust_region_trace_rate

activation_observables.measurement: Before each post-feedback surrogate fit, report the fraction of all accepted oracle observations represented exactly once by a reconstructible latent-code and score pair in the Gaussian-process training set, together with the number of newly incorporated pairs and the resulting training-set size.
activation_observables.name: oracle_feedback_gp_conditioning_coverage

activation_observables.measurement: On each round with more unique valid candidates than the announced batch and non-tied posterior draws, use the same recorded Gaussian-process Thompson draw to report the mean sampled value of the selected top batch minus the mean sampled value of the complete fresh candidate pool.
activation_observables.name: thompson_selected_batch_acquisition_lift

activation_observables.measurement: After each observe message, classify the round by whether accepted feedback improves its anchor, record any anchor replacement and trust-radius expansion or contraction, and report the fraction of state transitions that follow the declared success-expansion and failure-contraction rules before the next candidate pool is generated.
activation_observables.name: feedback_consistent_trust_region_update_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique valid canonical molecules entering the fresh acquisition pool per inverse-decoded perturbed latent point, with separate counts for invalid decodes, unchanged-anchor decodes, already evaluated molecules, earlier emitted molecules, and within-pool duplicates, plus whether the announced batch was filled.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_inverse_decode_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus and fixed SELFIES alphabet support a bounded sequence representation in which corpus and objective-session molecules can be encoded and reconstructed exactly by the trained SeqFlow pathway.

Uniform local perturbations of token-latent blocks around high-scoring evaluated anchors decode with enough valid novel yield to form a fresh pool larger than every announced batch within the proposal-attempt limit.

Oracle scores vary across the initial and adaptive observations, and objective value is locally regular enough in SeqFlow latent space for a Gaussian-process posterior to distinguish candidates from only 10 to 290 evaluated training points.
High-value regions are reachable from evaluated anchors through bounded changes to a subset of latent token blocks rather than requiring a disconnected global jump outside all adaptive trust regions.
The exact Gaussian-process fits and inverse-flow candidate generation remain computationally feasible under the supplied single-GPU, six-core, 16-GB profile and per-task timeout.

The method may underperform when SELFIES padding or tokenization aliases relevant chemistry, when decoded validity collapses near the best anchors, or when the objective is too discontinuous or deceptive for local latent posterior guidance.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if any representable objective-session molecule fails exact zero-perturbation SeqFlow round-trip reconstruction, if adaptive emissions cannot be traced to nonzero uniform token-block perturbations of oracle-evaluated anchors inside their recorded trust regions, or if accepted scores are not incorporated into the next Gaussian-process fit and no feedback-conditioned round selects its batch by the recorded posterior Thompson draw.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to build a fixed padded SELFIES token representation, train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow using only the unlabeled corpus, verify its encode/inverse round trips, and publish the vocabulary, configuration, and flow weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load the flow on logical cuda:0, encode only oracle-evaluated molecules and scores into a task-local Gaussian-process data set, choose high-scoring evaluated anchors, and create a fresh oversized pool each round by uniformly selecting eligible latent token blocks and perturbing them inside adaptive anchor-centered trust regions. Inverse-decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally reject invalid, unchanged, previously evaluated, previously emitted, or pool-duplicate molecules, draw from the fitted Gaussian-process posterior over the remaining pool, and emit exactly the evaluator-announced batch with the highest Thompson values. After observe, attach every accepted score to its exact latent code, refit the surrogate, and update anchors and trust-region radii by declared improvement and failure rules.
research_intent.mechanism: Learn an exactly reconstructible autoregressive SeqFlow map from padded SELFIES token sequences to continuous token-block latent codes, then conduct task-local Bayesian optimization entirely over oracle-evaluated latent-score pairs: generate de novo candidates by uniform blockwise perturbation inside adaptive trust regions centered on high-scoring evaluated anchors, inverse-decode a fresh valid novel pool, and use Gaussian-process posterior Thompson samples to choose each batch so returned rewards condition both later acquisition and trust-region state.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so the optimizer must learn a useful task-local posterior in a high-dimensional molecular space while producing a complete novel valid batch at every feedback round; a lossy latent representation, disconnected global sampling, or invalid local decodes can consume the limited proposal opportunity before oracle feedback is concentrated near improving structures.
